text: This staff report is about a matter for which the North York Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This is a report on the refusal to issue a permit by Municipal Licensing & Standards in the matter of an application for a boulevard cafe permit located at 3204 Yonge Street, Woburn Avenue flankage.

North York Community Council: 1. Approved the application for the proposed boulevard cafe permit located at 3204 Yonge Street, Woburn Avenue flankage, provided that there be no alcohol served in the boulevard area.
